subject: Security posture & SOC 2 - Private VPC options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Security posture & SOC 2 (post-call recap)

Alex —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can align your security/compliance checklist with how Redwood would run in a Private/VPC deployment: 

What we covered
- SOC 2: you mentioned SOC 2 Type I in progress (expected Q3). We validated that Redwood can support customers at SOC 2 Type II as well; we shared our attestation and controls mapping during the demo.
- GDPR/HIPAA: FinHealth will need data residency and BAA options for PHI. We discussed encryption at rest/in transit and KMS integration.
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): you asked whether we can start an initial questionnaire and share evidence for networking and access controls.
- Deployment posture: you prefer a Private VPC with limited egress and optional air-gapped mode for sensitive workloads.

Proposed next steps
1) Can you share the vendor security questionnaire (VSA/Vendor form) and a list of required artifacts (e.g., architecture diagram, SOC 2 reports, encryption docs)?
2) I’m attaching a high-level Redwood Private VPC deployment diagram and a VSQ template we usually pre-fill for customers. See attachments.
3) I’ll loop in Neha (security) and Monica (CS) to prepare controls mapping and a short runbook for the on-prem/air-gapped option.

Deliverables from Redwood by next Tue (2026-04-14):
- Pre-filled VSQ (initial pass)
- Architecture diagram with network controls and egress patterns
- SOC 2 evidence pointers and timeline notes

Questions for you
- Do you have a preferred format for the VSQ (Excel/Doc)?
- Any specific network vendors or firewall policies we should be aware of for the Private/VPC build?

Thanks — I’ll start the VSQ pre-fill and attach the diagram now.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Attachments:
- redwood-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf (pdf, 1 page)
- vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, template)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security posture & SOC 2 (post-call recap)

Marcus —

Appreciate the quick recap and attachments. A few quick answers and context from our side: 

- VSQ: Excel is preferred; I’ll upload our vendor form to the shared drive tomorrow morning.
- SOC 2: We currently have a Type I in progress and expect Type II by late Q3. We will need Redwood to sign a BAA for HIPAA-protected workloads and confirm data residency within the US for some customers.
- Deployment: Our security team prefers minimal egress and strict egress firewall rules. We also want to understand the air-gapped option — is that a separate on-prem package or an enhanced VPC mode?

Can you confirm what evidence you can provide immediately (e.g., list of standard controls, SOC 2 scope, encryption & key management docs)?

Thanks — I’ll drop the VSQ in the drive and loop in Priya from our procurement team if we need to start contract redlines.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FinHealth
alex.johnson@finhealth.com

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security posture & SOC 2 (post-call recap)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Short answers to your asks and what we can deliver this week: 

Immediate evidence we can share (this week) - Redwood SOC 2 summary and controls mapping (PDF) — attached as "soc2-attestation-statement-draft.pdf"
- KMS integration notes and envelope encryption diagram (section in the deployment pdf)
- Network controls: we’ll provide the VPC architecture diagram with default ingress/egress rules and an egress-lockdown profile for customers who require minimal outbound flows.

Air-gapped vs Private VPC - Private VPC: customer-managed VPC peering or PrivateLink with strict routing and firewall rules; we still run dedicated control-plane components in a managed plane.
- Air-gapped/on-prem: a separate on-prem deployment package (air-gapped appliance or VM bundle) with no external egress; typically used for highest-compliance customers. We can provide an operational runbook and checklist.

Next steps I’ll take
1) Pre-fill your VSQ and upload to the Drive (I’ll flag fields where we need customer input).
2) Share a simplified deployment diagram with labeled egress points and required firewall rules (Drive link below).
3) Neha will do a short controls mapping doc that lines up your VSQ rows to our evidence.

Drive links - Architecture diagram: https://drive.google.com/redwood/architecture/redwood-vpc-diagram
- VSQ (pre-fill): https://redwood.app/vsq/initiate?deal=DH-3281

If the procurement team wants to start with a templated BAA, Monica can kick off the legal template and share an editable DocuSign draft.

I’ll follow up Monday with the pre-filled VSQ and the controls mapping. Let me know if you want a quick 20-min call with Neha to walk through the air-gapped checklist.

Best,
Marcus

Attachments:
